system.flavor: A powerful autoloader machined to very close tolerances, with a 6.5-inch ported-compensator barrel. Popular with police units for its magazine capacity.
system.notes:
Solo of Fortune 2 p.33 text layer: P +1 J/L C 3D6 (11mm) 12/20 3 VR 50m 425eb. Corroborated by Blackhand's Street Weapons p.15 (PDF idx 16): 425eb, P +1 J/L C 3D6 (11MM) 12/20 3 VR 50M.

Printed shots are 12/20: a standard 12-round clip (Conceal. J) or the 20-round 'banana' magazine that ships with every gun (Conceal. L). SoF2's review warns the tolerances are too tight - if the gun is dropped on a hard surface, gets dirt in the action or overheats it locks up and must be stripped and cleaned before it will fire again.
